dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose matches its capabilities: list Echo assistants, retrieve assistant details and FAQs, and chat with an Echo via the Echo AI API. Chat calls can consume credits, but that is explicitly disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to Echo AI endpoints on auth.echoai.so and tell the agent to prefer free FAQ/profile answers and request explicit confirmation before paid chat calls.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is documentation-only markdown with no executable scripts. Installation is a manual copy into the OpenClaw skills directory plus setting ECHO_API_KEY and enabling the skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Using an Echo API key and sending chat messages to Echo AI are proportionate for this integration. The amount of accessible assistant data depends on whether the user chooses a workspace-wide or assistant-scoped key.

dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background process, privilege escalation, or hidden persistence is present. The skill does instruct reuse of session_id values for conversation continuity, which is expected but should stay scoped to the intended chat.

llm.guidance: Use this skill if you trust Echo AI and need your agent to interact with Echo assistants. Prefer an assistant-scoped API key when possible, avoid sending secrets or sensitive business data in chat messages, and approve credit-consuming chat calls only when you intend to spend credits.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: echo-ai
Version: 1.1.0

The OpenClaw skill for Echo AI is benign. It provides clear instructions for connecting to the Echo AI platform, listing assistants, retrieving knowledge bases, and chatting. Crucially, the `SKILL.md` explicitly instructs the AI agent to obtain user confirmation before initiating chat calls (which incur costs) and to prioritize answering questions from FAQs to avoid unnecessary charges. All API calls are directed to a single, consistent domain (`auth.echoai.so`), and there is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, or prompt injection designed to subvert the agent for harmful purposes. The skill promotes responsible and transparent interaction with the external API.
